summary: Mangoceuticals, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq notice granting a 180-day extension, until February 1, 2027, to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule. The company previously disclosed non-compliance on February 4, 2026. The notice allows continued listing pending the cure period, with a reverse stock split contemplated if necessary. The press release also references a previously announced business combination agreement with Nuclea Energy Inc., but no terms are detailed here. This filing is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special-situation event. What to watch: potential reverse split and progress of the Nuclea Energy deal.
